text: Got to say, these Sony XM5 headphones have been very impressive for me for a few weeks. I am absolutely amazed at how the ANC works. How it listens to the noise and plays a reverse wave that cancels out, it's really magic. So in a train, I don't hear any hum from the engine, and the people talking in my office, they just fade into the distance, they're like whispering. The sound quality is very rich, warm, really detailed. The fit is also very comfortable and firm. So the pros are, the ANC is excellent, the fit is super comfortable, the controls are very intuitive, the battery life is absurd. You can charge them very quickly and get many hours of use. Transparency mode works surprisingly well and is very natural. The case is very nice and suitable for travelling. The cons are that the pressure can be weird for some, the app is a bit fussy, and it is expensive. Also, I would say the ANC works best for low-frequency sound, so for noise that goes up and down in pitch, like people talking, it's not as good. But overall, if you want a quiet sound, I would buy these. I would rate them 5 stars.
